metrics.profile_summary: Results-driven Digital Marketing Manager with 6 years of experience specializing in SEO and performance marketing. Proven track record in lead generation and ROI optimization across UAE, UK, and US markets.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Software Engineering

experience.description: Manages multi-channel PPC and SEO strategies for international markets, reducing CPA by 30% and utilizing GA4 and Looker Studio for data-driven growth.
Led the SEO team to improve organic traffic by 90% through technical audits, keyword research, and optimized workflows.
Executed end-to-end SEO strategies, including keyword research and link building to increase search visibility and organic impressions.
Supported SEO campaigns via on-page optimization, content enhancements, and outreach for guest posting.

strengths: Expertise in GA4 and ad platform reporting
Strong track record of ROI and lead generation
Comprehensive technical SEO and PPC skill set
weaknesses: Degree is in Software Engineering rather than Marketing/Business
People management experience (~1 year) is below the 2-3 year requirement
evaluation.summary: Highly technical candidate with strong performance marketing skills and local availability. While lacking the specific degree and full management tenure, his ROI-focused results make him a strong fit.
